_comment: Optional. Copy to .deplyd.json at your repo root only if `deplyd -ShowConfig` shows something wrong. Every key is optional; each one overrides a single detection step.
_deployPattern: Regex matched against workflow filename and name to decide what counts as a deploy.
_environments: Replaces the detected environment list. Give an environment a `workflows` array to pin its workflows explicitly; that always wins over detection.
_scopes: Which paths each target covers, when the job sets no working-directory. Keyed by the label deplyd reports, which -ShowConfig will tell you.
_ignoreJobs: Substrings of job names that should never become targets.
